title: Image action param ignores its declared maxSize — no client-side size guard before upload, unlike the file param widget
body:
Split out of the QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7439 (records-forms FULL area, `upload-guard-blocks-confirm` FAIL — reproduced 2×). Filed here because the fix lands in this repo (file-at-destination rule). Filed by the triage seat; unassigned.

## Symptom

An image param declared with `maxSize` 5 MB (`p_cover` in the showcase Action Param Gallery) accepts an oversized file: a 6.3 MB PNG fires the full `presigned → PUT → complete` upload and renders a preview, with no rejection. The sibling file param (`p_attachments`, 10 MB) correctly rejects an oversized file with zero uploads.

Repro (from the QA run): Field Zoo → Specimen–Full row → run "Action Param Gallery"; set a >5 MB image on **Cover image** (`p_cover`). Expected: rejected before any upload, like the file param. Actual: full upload + preview, no size error.

## Anchors (verified at `origin/main` @ `92c0b1f`)

- The guard that works: `packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx:52` — `if (maxSize && file.size > maxSize) { … }` before upload, with the human-readable MB message.
- The config is delivered to both widgets: `packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:85` copies `maxSize: param.maxSize` for the param-to-field mapping regardless of type, so the image widget receives the constraint and ignores it.
- The image-side upload path (image param widget) performs no equivalent pre-upload size check — QA root cause: "the image-param widget lacks the client maxSize guard the file-param widget has".

## Direction

Mirror FileField's pre-upload guard in the image param widget (same message shape), so a declared `maxSize` is enforced before any presigned upload starts.

## Dedup

Searched open issues (`maxSize`, `upload`): no open card on this. No duplicate.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
